text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Windy, happy birthday! I brought Air<n>Groove along
to celebrate too!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Guh, I appreciate it, but also why?!<n>You brought the
scariest person<n>imaginable!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Windy, you tried biting into the<n>academy gates
again, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well, you are forgiven. Just this once.<n>I'll turn a
blind eye on account of it<n>being your birthday.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wha?! Is... is this real life?! Hold on,<n>this could be
my big chance!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove... I'm the one who<n>trampled your flower
bed! It<n>happened when Taiki and I were<n>playing tag.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Usually I do it on purpose, but that<n>time, just that
once, it was an<n>accident! Sooo...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Why, you little... Well, it's your special<n>day. As long
as you're sorry, I'll look<n>past that too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Today, you take another step toward<n>being an
adult—one who doesn't<n>cause trouble for others,
yes?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah... Uh-huh! Might be impossible,<n>but I
promise!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's great, Windy! You even got us<n>off the hook
for the flower bed<n>incident—that's double
happiness! ☆

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: About the flower bed... I never saidI'd let you off the hook, Taiki.
